text:
Maya Patel: Quick sync — Willow on-prem maintenance window booked for Thu 2025-11-27 02:00-03:00 UTC. Need deployment leads, smoke owners, and rollback standby. @Liam @Jess can you confirm availability?

Liam Chen: I can take deployment lead. I’ll be oncall that night. Planning a blue->green with N replicas.

Jess Ortega: I can run smoke tests and run the post-deploy checks. Will prepare a quick checklist.

Maya Patel: Thanks. Nishant, can you own rollback readiness (artifacts, playbook, DB migration fallback)?

Nishant Kumar: I’ll be standby for rollback. No DB migrations this change, so rollback is just traffic shift and image revert. I’ll stage the previous image in prod repo now.

Maya Patel: Nice. Here’s the proposed timeline:
- 01:30 UTC — all hands join #willow-maintenance (10m pre-check)
- 02:00 UTC — start shift traffic to maintenance pool, deploy canary to 10%
- 02:15 UTC — smoke tests run (Jess)
- 02:25 UTC — promote canary to 100% if green, update routing
- 02:40 UTC — post-deploy verification, metrics check
- 03:00 UTC — close window or rollback if necessary

Liam Chen: Sounds good. I’ll disable autoscale during the window and pin instance types. Also I’ll run a quick dry-run in staging today 17:00 PT to validate the RB toggle.

Jess Ortega: Smoke checklist draft (will post in thread):
```
- api/health -> 200 within 200ms
- /login flow basic -> success
- embedding service qps sanity -> within baseline
- sample chat gen -> coherent response, no garbled tokens
- slow-path trace check for kv-cache miss <= 300ms
```

Maya Patel: Exporting the checklist to the runbook. Add the exact curl/requests you’ll run.

deploy-bot: Scheduled maintenance slot created: Willow (on-prem) 2025-11-27 02:00-03:00 UTC. Reminder 1h before.

Nishant Kumar: Rollback playbook notes:
- revert routing (2 min)
- redeploy previous image (5-7 min)
- invalidate cache + restart workers if error rates spike
- notify customer SRE Slack and open incident channel if rollback invoked

Liam Chen: FYI I’ll keep a warm spare node ready in the same colo, and snapshot current images 30m prior.

Jess Ortega: I’ll add a small perf test to ensure tail latency hasn’t regressed after promotion.

Maya Patel: Final asks:
- Liam: confirm staging dry-run completes OK (post logs)
- Jess: paste exact smoke commands in thread by EOD PT
- Nishant: confirm previous image hash and that secrets rotation is not in this window

Liam Chen: Will do. :thumbsup:

Jess Ortega: Will post commands in ~2h.

Nishant Kumar: Previous image hash confirmed: sha256:7a1f3b... Secrets rotation scheduled next week, not during this window.

Maya Patel: Great. I’ll send calendar invites and set the 01:30 pre-check. Thanks all — we’ll call this ready unless something pops up. :raised_hands:
